about: Renders a track a person drags one thumb or two along to pick a value or a range. The arrow keys step the focused thumb, PageUp and PageDown step it tenfold, and Home and End set its bounds.

controlled.about: A controlled value in a field: the field's label names the thumb, and the helper text, which describes it, counts the seats and derives the monthly total.
controlled.title: Controlled, in a field

dragging.about: `Slider.DraggingIndicator` inside a thumb shows the thumb's value in a bubble above it while a person drags it, in the root's format.
dragging.title: Value while dragging

marks.about: `Slider.Marker` lays a dot on the track at a value, with its words below the thumb. The marker group comes before the thumb, so the thumb covers the dot it rests on. A `step` of 250 snaps the thumb to the tiers.
marks.title: Marks

origin.about: `origin="center"` fills the track from the middle to the thumb. `getAriaValueText` announces the side in words, and the value text shows the same words.
origin.title: From the centre

palette.about: The palette the range, the thumb's edge and the focus ring read. An invalid slider takes the error palette in place of any of them.
palette.title: Palettes

range.about: Two thumbs pick a range. Each thumb is named after the label and its own `label`, such as "Price Minimum", and `minStepsBetweenThumbs` keeps them five steps apart. The hidden inputs submit `price[]` twice.
range.title: A range

rtl.about: `dir="rtl"` mirrors the slider for a right-to-left page: the label starts at the right, the range fills from the right edge, and ArrowLeft steps the value up.
rtl.title: Right to left

size.about: The thumb is a circle of the tag height, 21.6, 24 and 26.4px, and the track reads the gap scale, 4, 6 and 8px, from `sm` to `lg`.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: A disabled slider is dimmed and leaves the tab order. A read-only one keeps its tab stop, dashes its thumb's edge and refuses every key. An invalid one takes the error palette.
states.title: States

title: Slider

variant.about: The progress bar's two track looks. The outline thumb is a panel circle with an edge in the palette's solid, and the subtle thumb is a solid circle with a panel ring.
variant.title: Looks

vertical.about: `orientation="vertical"` lays the track on the block axis. Five bands from the centre share a fieldset's legend, and each is named by its own label.
vertical.title: Vertical
